reviews.title: Price and quality are amazing!!!!
reviews.comment: Great value. Excellent quality. Little smaller than full tower standard used to be . But built with good quality materials . Everything lines up and functions. Case has many features and many interesting configurations. Please use provided motherboard screws. The motherboard stand offs use a different screw threads from ones that are usually used . Cross threading is guaranteed if not paint attention. Ask me how I know that. Very happy with the product. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Roman C.

reviews.title: Solid Built Case

reviews.title: EATX Case that wont hold two GPUs
reviews.comment: Gorgeous case, totally worth it if you have a large mobo and oversized single gpu. But for an E-ATX that can't hold 2 GPUs because the lower ARCTIC shroud holding the PSU completely takes up the vertical space leading up the 2nd GPU and it doest not fit. 2 x R9700s are the cards I have. Luckily I had another Phanteks Evolv 2 case as well (I'm building an AI server farm) and the 2 x 9700s fit in the Phanteks. So this monstrous case is essentially restricted to a single GPU for inference loads vs dual GPUs.
reviews.author: KD
